notes.title: Dark Night 2.0 (Update)
notes.content:
Dark Night is going to get a update soon this or next week!

Note from Developer;

The reason for no updates or replies is because i lost ALL data of Dark Night a few weeks back. So now i am working on a brand new update (2.0) to recreate Dark Night.

It will be a new location, bit changed gameplay mechanics, and just better working game overall!

-Daniel

notes.title: Regarding The New Update.
notes.content:
I am in the middle of fixing everything to make everything right.

I am going to make the game a lot better and please wait and see the next update (called 1.2) and then please give the game a review.

It should be released within the next two weeks. So please wait until that update arrives :)

-Daniel

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
Hey, so i really needed to fix a few features. So this update is coming very soon and containing the following features!

+PaPa does not insta kill you. He however will chase you ;)
+He starts counting down later (not the beginning)
And more fixes!

Stay tuned ;)
